summary: First release of a new service. There is no existing data or traffic to protect, so the release risk is low; the risks that remain are properties of the design that were accepted knowingly, chiefly the unauthenticated API.

residualRisks.mitigation: Expose it only behind a trusted gateway. Per-client rate limiting bounds abuse.

residualRisks.risk: Clicks buffered at the moment the process stops are lost.
residualRisks.mitigation: Accepted as best-effort analytics for this version and documented; flushing on shutdown is the next change.

residualRisks.risk: Short links can point at malicious sites.
residualRisks.mitigation: Scheme and credential rules are enforced now; destination reputation checks are a recorded follow-up.
Run one instance. The readiness probe reports database trouble.

rollbackPlan: Remove the deployed directory; nothing existed before this release, so there is no earlier version to restore.
Delete the SQLite file at DATABASE_PATH if the data should not be kept.
postReleaseChecks: Create a link, follow it, and confirm the click appears in its stats within the flush interval.
Send more than the burst of creation requests from one client and confirm 429 with Retry-After.
